svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 掩耳盗铃 (traditional 掩耳盜鈴), yǎn ěr dào líng, “Cover your ears to steal a bell”. Skipping the flaky test doesn't make the bug go away. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.
